definitions.explanation: Cancer arising in the stomach. Historically one of the most common cancers in Japan, which is why gastric screening is a standard part of adult health check-ups.

examples.japanese: {胃癌|いがん}と{診断|しんだん}された。
examples.english: He was diagnosed with stomach cancer.

examples.japanese: {早期|そうき}の{胃癌|いがん}は{治|なお}る{可能性|かのうせい}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: Early-stage stomach cancer has a high chance of being cured.

examples.japanese: {胃癌|いがん}の{検診|けんしん}は、{四十歳|よんじゅっさい}を{過|す}ぎたら{定期的|ていきてき}に{受|う}けたほうがいい。
examples.english: Once you pass forty, you should have regular screenings for stomach cancer.

notes:
{胃|い} (stomach) + {癌|がん} (cancer), with rendaku voicing がん to a compound reading いがん. Often written {胃|い}がん in newspapers, since {癌|がん} is outside the common-use kanji list.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {胃癌|いがん}になる: to develop stomach cancer
- {胃癌|いがん}の{手術|しゅじゅつ}: surgery for stomach cancer
- {胃癌|いがん}{検診|けんしん}: gastric cancer screening
- {早期|そうき}{胃癌|いがん}: early-stage stomach cancer

RELATED WORDS:
- {肺癌|はいがん}: lung cancer
- {大腸癌|だいちょうがん}: colon cancer
- {胃炎|いえん}: gastritis
